hints.move: Drag to move the layer (or the selected pixels). Arrows nudge, Shift+arrows by 10.
hints.marqueeRect: Drag to select. Shift: square / add · Alt: from centre / subtract.
hints.marqueeEllipse: Drag to select. Shift: circle / add · Alt: from centre / subtract.
hints.lasso: Drag around an area to select it.
hints.polyLasso: Click to add corners; click the first point or press Enter to close.
hints.magicWand: Click a color to select similar pixels.
hints.crop: Drag the box or its edges, then press Enter. Esc cancels.
hints.eyedropper: Click to pick the foreground color. Alt+click picks the background color.
hints.ruler: Drag to measure distance and angle.
hints.spotHeal: Paint over a blemish — it's filled from its surroundings.
hints.heal: Alt+click to set a source, then paint. Texture is matched to the spot.
hints.redEye: Drag a box around an eye.
hints.brush: Paint with the foreground color. [ ] change the size.
hints.pencil: Paint hard-edged pixels with the foreground color.
hints.colorReplace: Paint to recolor while keeping shading.
hints.clone: Alt+click to set a source, then paint to copy it.
hints.historyBrush: Paint back how the photo looked when it was opened.
hints.magicEraser: Click a color to erase similar pixels.
hints.gradient: Drag to draw a gradient from the foreground color.
hints.bucket: Click to fill similar pixels with the foreground color.
hints.liquify: Push, pinch or bloat pixels; Restore paints the original back.
hints.type: Click to add text, or click text to edit it. Ctrl+Enter finishes.
hints.rectangle: Drag to draw a rectangle. Shift: square.
hints.ellipse: Drag to draw an ellipse. Shift: circle.
hints.line: Drag to draw a line. Shift snaps to 45°.
hints.hand: Drag to scroll around the photo (or hold Space with any tool).
hints.zoom: Click to zoom in, Alt+click to zoom out. Ctrl+wheel also zooms.
hints.pen: Click to add corners, drag for curves; click the first point to close. Enter ends the path.
hints.freeformPen: Drag to draw a smooth path.
hints.pathSelect: Drag anchors or handles; Alt-click an anchor to make it a corner; Delete removes it.

home.subtitle: Layers, masks, selections, brushes, healing, 50+ filters, 20 adjustments and Generative Fill — right in your browser. Your photos stay on this device.
home.dropHint: Drop an image here or choose a file (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, AVIF).
home.newHint: Start from an empty document in any size.

home.storageError: Couldn't read saved photos from this browser.
home.learnBody: Open a practice photo and follow a step-by-step tour of every tool — try each one as you go.

paths.empty: No paths yet. Draw one with the Pen tool (P).

tour.promptBody: A short tutorial shows every tool, one at a time, and lets you try each one.

welcome.title: Welcome to the photo editor
welcome.body: This tour visits every part of the editor and every tool, one at a time. Each tool is picked for you — try it on the photo, then press Next. You can stop any time and come back from Help → Tutorial.

menubar.title: Menus
menubar.body: Everything the editor can do is in these menus: open and export files, undo, resize the image, add layers, filters, selections and more. Each item shows its keyboard shortcut.

options.title: Tool options
options.body: This bar changes with the tool you pick: brush size and softness, how strict the magic wand is, the crop ratio… Check it whenever you switch tools.

toolbar.title: Tools
toolbar.body: Your tools, grouped by job. A small triangle means there are more tools in the group — click the active tool again (or right-click it) to see them. Each tool has a one-letter shortcut.

canvas.title: Your photo
canvas.body: This is where you work. Scroll to move around, hold Ctrl and scroll to zoom, and hold Space and drag to pan with any tool.

panels.title: Panels
panels.body: Panels show details of your photo: colours, properties, adjustments, layers, paths and history. Click the tabs to switch, or open more from the Window menu.

status.title: Status bar
status.body: Shows the zoom (type a number to change it), the photo's size, where your pointer is, and a tip for the current tool.

quickMask.title: Quick Mask
quickMask.body: Press Q to paint a selection with brushes: black hides, white selects. Press Q again to turn your painting into a selection.

colors.title: Colours
colors.body: The top square is the colour you paint with, the bottom one is the background colour. Click one to change it, X swaps them, D resets to black and white.

layers.title: Layers
layers.body: A photo is a stack of layers, like sheets of glass. Edit one without touching the others; drag to reorder, click the eye to hide, change the blend mode and opacity at the top.

groups.title: Groups
groups.body: Keep layers tidy in groups: Ctrl-click layers to pick several, then press Ctrl+G. Groups can be opened and closed, moved together, and have their own opacity, mask and effects.

masks.title: Layer masks
masks.body: A mask hides parts of a layer without erasing them. Add one with this button, then paint black to hide and white to bring things back.

adjustments.title: Adjustments
adjustments.body: Change colour and light — brightness, curves, hue, black & white and more. These add an adjustment layer, so you can change or remove it later without harming the photo.

properties.title: Properties
properties.body: Settings for whatever is selected: an adjustment's sliders, a text layer's font, a shape's colours, a mask's softness, or quick actions like Remove background.

paths.title: Paths panel
paths.body: Paths you draw with the pen live here. Turn one into a selection, fill it or stroke it with the brush.

history.title: History
history.body: Every change you make is listed here. Click an earlier step to go back in time — or just press Ctrl+Z to undo.

imageMenu.title: Image menu
imageMenu.body: Resize the image or the canvas, rotate or flip it, crop to a selection, and apply adjustments straight to the pixels. Auto Tone, Auto Contrast and Auto Color fix a photo in one click.

filterMenu.title: Filters
filterMenu.body: More than 50 filters — blurs, sharpening, noise, distortions, artistic looks and lens correction. Each one shows a live preview before you apply it.

transform.title: Transform
transform.body: Edit → Free Transform (Ctrl+T) resizes and rotates a layer. Under Edit → Transform you'll also find Skew, Distort, Perspective and Warp to bend it into shape. Press Enter to apply.

selectMenu.title: Select menu
selectMenu.body: Select everything, invert, pick the main subject automatically, select by colour, and soften or grow a selection.

taskBar.title: Quick actions
taskBar.body: This bar suggests the next step. With a selection you can fill it with AI (Generative fill), remove what's inside, or turn it into a mask; without one, select the subject or remove the background.

save.title: Saving and exporting
save.body: Your photo saves itself in this browser — watch the badge. To get an image file, use File → Export as (PNG, JPG or WebP).

done.title: You've seen it all!
done.body: That's every tool. Take your time to experiment — Ctrl+Z always undoes. Start this tutorial again any time from Help → Tutorial or the button in the status bar.

tools.move: Moves the selected layer, or just the selected pixels when there's a selection. Groups move with everything inside.
tools.marqueeRect: Selects a rectangle. Edits then only affect the inside of the selection.
tools.marqueeEllipse: Selects an oval or a circle.
tools.lasso: Selects a free shape you draw by hand.
tools.polyLasso: Selects a shape made of straight sides, one click per corner.
tools.magicWand: Selects areas of similar colour with one click — great for skies or plain backgrounds.
tools.crop: Cuts the photo to a new frame. Pick a ratio such as 1:1 or 16:9 in the options bar.
tools.eyedropper: Picks a colour from the photo to paint with.
tools.ruler: Measures distance and angle. Straighten turns a tilted horizon level.
tools.spotHeal: Removes spots and small blemishes: paint over one and it's filled from the area around it.
tools.heal: Copies texture from one place to another while blending with the colour and light of the spot you paint.
tools.redEye: Fixes red eyes from a camera flash.
tools.clone: Copies one part of the photo onto another, pixel for pixel.
tools.historyBrush: Paints back how the photo looked when you opened it, only where you brush.
tools.brush: Paints soft or hard strokes in the foreground colour.
tools.pencil: Paints hard-edged pixels — handy for fine details and pixel art.
tools.colorReplace: Recolours what you paint over while keeping its shading.
tools.magicEraser: Erases all similar colour with one click.
tools.gradient: Fills with a smooth blend from one colour to another.
tools.bucket: Fills an area of similar colour with the foreground colour.
tools.sharpen: Crisps up detail where you paint.
tools.smudge: Smears pixels like a finger in wet paint.
tools.liquify: Pushes, pinches or bloats pixels — subtle reshaping.
tools.sponge: Makes colours more or less vivid where you paint.
tools.type: Adds text you can edit later: font, size, colour and alignment.
tools.rectangle: Draws a rectangle shape layer — set fill, outline and rounded corners.
tools.ellipse: Draws an ellipse or circle shape layer.
tools.polygon: Draws a polygon with as many sides as you like.
tools.line: Draws a straight line shape layer.
tools.pen: Draws precise paths with straight lines and smooth curves. Paths become selections, fills or strokes.
tools.freeformPen: Draws a path freehand; it's smoothed for you.
tools.pathSelect: Moves a path's points and curve handles, or the whole path.
tools.zoom: Zooms in where you click (Alt-click zooms out).

footer.made: Free, in English and Arabic, right in your browser.
